title: DPD Polska Goes Live on Creatio with 1,000 Users in Five Weeks
summary: Poland’s largest courier company turns customer feedback into operational improvements with Creatio
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale — today announced that DPD Polska has expanded its Creatio rollout to 1,500 users across all 62 of its branches. The initial rollout reached 1,000 users in five weeks, three weeks ahead of plan. The platform gives DPD’s teams one place to capture what customers tell them and turn those insights into operational improvements.


DPD Polska has spent 35 years building one of Poland’s largest courier networks. Today, around 10,000 couriers work with the company, and its DPD Pickup network includes over 35,000 drop-off and collection points nationwide. Operating at that scale means customer messages contain valuable information for the teams managing parcels and orders every day.


When DPD set out to modernize its technology, it looked for a partner that understood how those teams work. Rather than organizing the system solely around the customer, DPD needed it to reflect the parcels and orders at the heart of its operations and make it easier to route and act on incoming messages.


Before building the solution, DPD analyzed thousands of customer messages and defined scenarios for routing them. This helped ensure the system reflected how work was actually done from day one.


DPD chose Creatio to support both its long technology history and internal, operations-led change. The system gathers information from customers and from the services around each parcel and order and turns that data into concrete efficiency gains.


“The need for this system came straight from our operations teams. Our work revolves around the parcel and the order, not only the customer, and much of our communication with customers still happens by email. We needed a partner who understood that. With Creatio, we went live in five weeks instead of the planned eight. Today over 1,000 people across all our micro-regions use it to turn what customers tell us into real operational improvements”, said Urszula Tomczyk, OPS Director, DPD Polska


The system was introduced in phases across all its branches and Contact Center, reflecting the company’s organizational structure. Urszula shared “We started with our most demanding region on purpose. If the system worked there, it would work everywhere. Five weeks later we were live, three weeks ahead of plan.”


The project shows how an established logistics company can modernize without disrupting its operations: by starting with the people closest to the work and building the system around how that work is actually done.


**About DPD Poland**


[DPD Polska](https://www.dpd.com.pl/) is part of Geopost, a European leader in parcel delivery and e-commerce solutions. The company provides high-quality services to senders and recipients, offering three delivery options: directly by courier, to a DPD Pickup point, or to a DPD Pickup parcel locker.


DPD Polska operates a network of nearly 35,000 DPD Pickup locations, including nearly 13,000 parcel lockers, and works with approximately 10,000 couriers. The company has more than 60 branches across Poland, with five key sorting hubs at the heart of its infrastructure: NCS Stryków, WRS Brwinów, SRS Ruda Śląska, HDR Swędów, and HLU Lućmierz.


In 2026, DPD Polska’s electric fleet comprises more than 670 vehicles, including over 100 electric cargo bikes. That same year, Forbes magazine named DPD Polska one of Poland’s Best Employers for the sixth time.
